contract_fields._comment: Every capability carries a `contract` with all six keys, non-empty. Enforced by scripts/capability-audit.py --check. A capability may not be promoted above PARTIAL unless every contract field is a concrete claim (not 'unknown'/'TBD'). `live_verification` is honest about provider access: 'BLOCKED - ...' when no live DB/deploy check was run this session. Browser runtime is verified automatically by scripts/verify-runtime.js (capability-evidence.yml + ci-local.sh --all).
contract_fields.entrypoint: the shipped file(s) a user or gate actually reaches this capability through
contract_fields.data_contract: where state lives: named Supabase table(s)/RPC(s) and key columns, or 'device-local', or 'none (static/client-only)'
contract_fields.authorization: the boundary that decides who may read/write: RLS policy name + grant, is_platform_owner() gate, approval guard, or 'n/a (no server data)'
contract_fields.failure_path: how a failed operation surfaces to the user or gate; names the check (.error handling) or records the gap
contract_fields.static_evidence: the automated/static check that proves the above without a live system: a script, CI step, or test
contract_fields.live_verification: result of a real production DB/deploy check, with date - or 'BLOCKED - <reason>' when none was possible

contract.entrypoint: omega-local-backup.js (OmegaBackup.exportKeys/importKeys - JSON file the user saves/loads), omega-export.js, omega-nexus-export.js, upload.js (OmegaStorage.upload/publicUrl/signedUrl)
contract.data_contract: export: reads localStorage keys and writes a Blob download; no server round-trip. upload: Supabase Storage bucket, path <user-id>/<timestamp>_<safe-name>, 5 GB client cap
contract.authorization: backup export/import is device-local (no auth needed, no server data leaves the browser); OmegaStorage.upload requires an auth session and writes under the caller's own user-id prefix; storage.objects RLS measured live 2026-08-31 - RLS enabled, INSERT policies 'avatars write'/'uploads write' both WITH CHECK (bucket_id = <bucket> AND (storage.foldername(name))[1] = auth.uid()::text), SELECT 'uploads read' scoped to own prefix OR is_platform_owner(), SELECT 'avatars read' unscoped (that bucket is public:true), UPDATE only on avatars. No DELETE policy on either bucket - see live_verification
contract.failure_path: OmegaStorage.upload RETURNS { error } (it never throws) on missing bucket / missing or non-File argument / over the 5 GB cap / no session / storage error, and every one of the four call sites now checks that .error before its success path. Both halves were shipped broken: profile.html and marketplace.html passed (file, bucket) instead of (bucket, file), which raised a TypeError inside upload() that their try/catch swallowed, and publishing.html ignored the returned error - all three reported success after uploading nothing. scripts/tests/test_storage_upload_contract.py gates both halves. Import wraps JSON.parse in try/catch; a member-supplied image URL rendered back must be esc()'d (stored-XSS history)
contract.static_evidence: omega-local-backup.js / upload.js parse under node --check; the 5-with-export / 43-without split is measured by scripts/evidence-audit.py; CLAUDE.md 8.2 records which finance pages carry the export path; scripts/tests/test_storage_upload_contract.py (7 tests) asserts every OmegaStorage.upload call passes the bucket first and inspects its own result's .error, and asserts upload() returns {error} rather than throwing - all four mutations (swapped args, either dropped .error check, restored throw) fail it
contract.live_verification: LIVE-VERIFIED 2026-08-31 against project ydqhzvvoyufiiqvzcjns, by member impersonation in-database (set_config role=authenticated + request.jwt.claims sub=<member uuid>), each attempt inside a rolled-back transaction: insert into own prefix ALLOWED; into another member's prefix DENIED 42501 (uploads AND avatars); into the bucket root with no uid prefix DENIED 42501; into an undeclared bucket DENIED 42501. No spoofing gap. OPEN, recorded not fixed: delete of one's own upload is also DENIED 42501 - there is no DELETE policy on storage.objects, so a member can never remove a file they uploaded; no client code offers a delete, so this is a gap, not a shipped bug. Both buckets currently hold 0 objects. Also runtime-verified 2026-08-31 via scripts/verify-runtime.js (headless chromium): vault.html, settings.html, profile.html, marketplace.html, publishing.html, marketing.html all load, approval guard lifts, no uncaught error, no horizontal overflow, no duplicate id.
